newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso firms amid export earnings influx.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso firms amid export earnings influx.

text.p: Colombia's peso gained 0.5 pesos to close at 1,074.1 against the dollar as corporations bought pesos to pay tax bills and oil and coffee export earnings flowed into the markets, interbank traders said.

"The dollar started to fall because today was the deadline for large taxpayers to pay the first installment on tax bills," said one dealer. She added that earnings from tradtional export sectors were also being ploughed back into the market.
The fall was offset by demand for greenbacks from some sectors of industry, mainly vehicle assembly plants and banks looking to square dollar positions.
Traders reported 248 operations worth a total $105.8 million. The peso hit an intraday high of 1,072 and sank to an intraday low of 1,074.5.
